title: a match starts and runs
expected: GameManager.State == Playing with a spawned roster
actual: Playing, 4 Blue / 4 Red, 4 enemies, clock 0.0 s

title: the human is on the Blue roster and free to move
expected: registered, not captured, motor not frozen
actual: BluePlayer free, in its home base

title: walking to the prison frees the prisoner
expected: isCaptured == false after the rescuer reaches the prison
actual: still captured 1.2 s after the player stood at the prison - the rescue rule did not fire

title: the enemy flag can be taken and the carry penalty arms
a dropped flag returns home after 10 s
actual: returned home in 1.7 real s at 20x = ~35 game s

title: resume continues the match
expected: the clock runs again after Resume
actual: clock did not advance in 0.7 s after Resume

title: sending the app to the background pauses the match
actual: GameManager has no OnApplicationPause handler, so backgrounding cannot pause anything

title: backgrounding pauses the match
expected: State == Paused after a background event

title: restart starts a clean match
expected: clock near the full time and outcome None

title: 100 rapid catches
expected: no exception, the counter stays consistent

title: 50 rapid pick-up attempts
expected: no exception, the flag ends in one consistent state

title: phase 20 must finish inside 30 s
actual: stalled in phase 20 for over 30 s

title: the clock running out ends the match as a draw
actual: Outcome was Elimination after the clock expired

title: carrying the enemy flag home wins the match
expected: flag delivery ending plus a victory feedback line
actual: outcome None, victory feedback seen = True

title: the enemy carrying our flag home loses the match
expected: flag delivery ending plus a defeat feedback line
actual: outcome None, defeat feedback seen = True

title: the AI read-out is editor-only
expected: showAiDebug true inside the editor, false in a player build
